releases.name: Phux Rune 0.1.44
releases.body:
**Phux Rune 0.1.44**: changes since public 0.1.42. No public 0.1.43 release was tagged.

- Keep phone Settings **Text size** and **Interface size** controls readable and their minus/value/plus groups reachable at the largest accessibility text size. Labels wrap above the controls and values are larger, without shrinking the requested text. Desktop layout and existing Interface zoom behavior are unchanged. (#2683)
- Update Rune from `78efd4a` to `1ff57939`. Adopt Rune's empty-field accessibility-tree correction, including empty → Unicode → clear → retype transitions, and the Wayland content/frame corner fix with its `sctk-adwaita` patch. (#2683)
- Strengthen isolated native simulator qualification with payload-free enrollment/publication evidence, sealed preparation-failure captures, and Apple's boot-readiness check. These are development diagnostics and gates, not new phone logging or a claimed performance or enrollment-latency fix. (#2677, #2690)

releases.name: Phux Rune 0.1.41
releases.body:
**Phux Rune 0.1.41**

- **More deliberate phone pane navigation.** Move and pane-map swipes follow the first deliberate axis rather than drifting diagonally into another pane. Small movements keep the preview still. Terminal scrolling, input ownership and the server-stored pane arrangement are unchanged. (#2668)
- **Scrollable source documents.** Long native source documents can reach their final lines, using Rune's line-wise layout and a constrained vertical scroller. Unicode/CRLF copying and blank-line placement are preserved; the configured Markdown viewer remains in place. (#2668)
- **Composable public runtime.** Public operations support composing exact launches, questions, actions and events from external tools. (#2662)
- **More reliable cold native builds.** Pinned Zig dependencies can be fetched from their verified mirror while retaining their original package hashes. (#2666)

Rune's upstream pins advance from `53299316` to `78efd4a`, including the line-wise document-layout adoption.

[All changes since 0.1.40](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/compare/rune-v0.1.40...rune-v0.1.41)
